fact_text: Al Meezan Investment Management offers a minor account product in which a guardian controls the account until the child grows up, while the child can still see the balance.

fact_text: The company's CEO suggested that a child's first mutual fund investment should sit in a very low-risk money market fund, so the child sees steady growth rather than losses.
